text:
Nora V: Quick docs sync: I'm adding an observability appendix to the Dedicated provisioning guide that shows recommended metrics and an example alert for autoscale thrashing when isolation labels are used. Support asked for concrete Prometheus rules and a short explainer.

Sam C: great. keep it minimal: one metric for 'scale_actions_per_minute', one for 'placement_latency_seconds', and an example alert that suggests increasing cooldown to 300s or enabling graceful_scale.

Iqbal R: runtime confirms metric names: `redwood_autoscale_actions_total` (counter), `redwood_placement_duration_seconds` (histogram), and `redwood_pool_replicas` (gauge). pls include a short note about cardinality if customers instrument many pools.

Marta L: also add a small runbook snippet: when alert fires, check placement latency and whether tenant_isolation labels were recently changed; then bump cooldown and monitor for 15m. customers like copy-paste runbooks.

Nora V: drafting examples. Prometheus alert rule (suggested):
```yaml
- alert: AutoscaleThrashing
  expr: increase(redwood_autoscale_actions_total{pool="$POOL"}[5m]) > 10
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Pool {{ $labels.pool }} showing frequent autoscale actions"
    description: "If placement_latency_seconds is high or tenant_isolation was changed recently, consider increasing scalePolicy.cooldown to >=300s or enable graceful_scale. See docs link."
```

Nora V: sample PromQL to check placement latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_placement_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))`

Sam C: wording nit: change 'enable graceful_scale' to 'consider enabling graceful_scale on dedicated pools (opt-in)'. 

Iqbal R: agree. also add a short cardinality note: "If you have thousands of pools, avoid high-cardinality labels on these metrics; prefer aggregating by team/region."

Marta L: runbook one-liner to remediate (CLI): `rwctl pool patch --id $POOL --set scalePolicy.cooldown=300s --set scalePolicy.graceful_scale=true` and add a second line: `# monitor replicas and actions for 30m before reverting`

Nora V: good. adding a short SLA cross-ref: "Note: changing cooldown reduces oscillation but does not alter capacity accounting; time still counts toward Dedicated capacity commitments." linking to /docs/dedicated/sla/commitments.md.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5401 branch: docs/dedicated/observability-autoscale 

Sam C: small ask: can we include a 2-row table in the appendix showing "cause -> quick action" (e.g., high placement_latency -> increase cooldown; many scale actions -> enable graceful_scale + investigate traffic pattern)? support loves that.

Nora V: adding the tiny table and a single-sentence rationale for each action. keeping examples short so they fit in the handbook.

Iqbal R: runtime approved the metric names and the recommended thresholds used in the examples. left a short inline note in the PR about pool-level vs cluster-level aggregation.

docs-bot: CI: lint ok, link-checker flagged one relative link to docs/dedicated/sla.md. Suggested fix: /docs/dedicated/sla/commitments.md

Nora V: fixed the link in the branch and pushed. action items: (1) me: merge once CI green, (2) Sam: add the new appendix link to the provisioning index, (3) Marta: convert runbook to a short pagerplay doc for SRE. aim to merge today.

docs-bot: PR merged (5401) by Nora V  deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/observability-autoscale.html

Sam C: verified staging. appendix looks useful and concise. leaving one tiny grammar nit.

Marta L: will draft the short pagerplay and paste link into the handbook after prod promotion. closing thread.
